verdict.rationale: The Uptime API reference shows versioned endpoints (e.g., https://incidents.betterstack.com/api/v2/monitors), so path-based API versioning exists. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or a changelog for version transitions. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit versioning guarantees or changelog, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.
